echo -n "primary" > /var/lib/failover/replica.role && echo "OK: replica.role now says 'primary'"

# Step 3: Switch proxy to the promoted replica
echo -n "8082" > /var/lib/failover/upstream && echo "OK: upstream now points to 8082"
